infobox.effect: Provides 196 inventory slots while only taking up 16

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Cannot be stored in a backpack.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Lucky Scav Junk box is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 196 inventory slots in a 14x14 grid and only takes up 16 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- barter items
- Posters

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from A Healthy Alternative

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - Easter eggs and References: The Lucky Scav Junk box is modeled after the 0500 Protector Transport Case.
